audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits 53.3% WR over 1030 games — Talon dominates every pre-6 stage, Kassadin is the classic weak-early scaler; only the 2+ item row flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side said 'Skill' while content win[6] and the packet chart both say Kassadin.
audit.why: By 2+ items his magic-shield scaling and 2s-cooldown Riftwalk hard-outscale Talon's burst — the content layer already states it.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side moved to Kassadin, why rewritten to match; rows 0-5 already agree on Talon.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text names Talon's R 'Shadow Assassin' (real: Shadow Assault). breakdown.cooldowns had no digit. Missing interaction: Kassadin's combo opens with the Nether Blade (W) auto-attack reset — the burst tell was unmentioned.
audit.why: Kit: Riftwalk 5/3.5/2s, Null Sphere 9s with a magic shield, Force Pulse 21s rank 1 and needs nearby casts, Nether Blade 7s auto reset.
audit.corrected: Name fixed, real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, W-reset tell added to dontsFull[2].d.

audit.why: The commit windows are Null Sphere's 9s and the gap after a Riftwalk (5s rank 1).

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Assassin's Path like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1, 2s at rank 3 — commit only in the gap after he blinks. - Null Sphere shield is a 9s cooldown; all-in when it's spent. - Force Pulse needs 21s and nearby casts — his slow is rarely loaded pre-6.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: A crashed wave is the alibi — Kassadin can't punish a shoved lane pre-6, so every crash buys a free river window.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: His combo opens with the Nether Blade auto reset — the wind-up is your step-back cue; post-6 Riftwalk is 5s.

edits.before: Late Talon flanks from coordinates wards don't cover: R in, string the carry, blade-exit through the wall.
edits.after: By 2+ items his magic shield and 2s Riftwalk outscale your burst — flank their carry, never the Kassadin.

edits.before: You still have R (Shadow Assassin) burst on him, but the moment he gets Riftwalk (R) he can blink away from your all-in; commit only when his R is on cooldown or he lacks the mana to double-blink.
edits.after: You still have R (Shadow Assault) burst on him, but the moment he gets Riftwalk (R) he can blink away from your all-in; commit only when his R is on cooldown or he lacks the mana to double-blink.
